items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: John Hammond was on the same boat. And Collins got kind of drunk, and he called Louis a black nigger. And Hammond heard it and knocked him down. ... Louis told me this story.

ctx.x: And they were going to Europe, and Collins got drunk. John Hammond was on the same boat. And Collins got kind of drunk, and he called Louis a black nigger. And Hammond heard it and knocked him down. And Hammond was a young guy then. Louis told me this story. And he told Hammond -- when he told -- he told Collins, he said, I'm through with you;when we get over this trip, I don't want no
more to do with you. So that's why he had a lot of managerial trouble when he was over in Europe, and he fired Collins and got rid of him.
